evals.prompt: Add Pix refunds to our support tool: agents can refund a Pix payment fully or partially.
evals.expected_output: A devolução against the original endToEndId, partial amounts bounded by the remaining refundable value, idempotent per refund reference, ledger entries and an audit of who refunded, the refund window stated, and tests.

Implements the check-digit algorithm and normalizes formatted input
Rejects the repeated-digit numbers such as 111.111.111-11
